title_en: Xi'an Lintong District Construction Engineering Company v. Shaanxi Hengsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over construction project contract
ruling_gist_en: Article 21 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts provides that where the parties conclude two different versions of a contract for the same construction project and the substantive content of the separately concluded construction contract is inconsistent with the filed winning bid contract, the filed winning bid contract shall be used as the basis for settling the project price. This provision means that when the parties enter into two different versions of a contract for the same construction project and a dispute arises, the filed winning bid contract shall be used as the basis for settling the project price, not the archived contract text.

西安市临潼区建筑工程公司与陕西恒升
房地产开发有限公司建设工程施工合同纠纷案

【裁判摘要】

最高人民法院《关于审理建设工程施工合同纠纷案件适用法律问题的解释》第二十一条关于"当事人就同一建设工程另行订立的建设工程施工合同与经过备案的中标合同实质性内容不一致的，应当以备案的中标合同作为结算工程价款的根据"的规定，是指当事人就同一建设工程签订两份不同版本的合同，发生争议时应当以备案的中标合同作为结算工程价款的根据，而不是指以存档合同文本作为结算工程价款的依据。

最高人民法院民事判决书

（2007）民一终字第74号

上诉人（原审原告）：西安市临潼区建筑工程公司，住所地：陕西省西安市临潼区东关街21号。

法定代表人：孙刚，该公司总经理。

委托代理人：韩松，北京市康达律师事务所西安分所律师。

委托代理人：王东宽，该公司职工。

被上诉人（原审被告）：陕西恒升房地产开发有限公司，住所地：陕西省西安市东关南街大新巷4号。

法定代表人：何西京，该公司总经理。

委托代理人：翟存柱，北京市中凯律师事务所律师。

委托代理人：郝雅玲，北京市中凯律师事务所律师。

西安市临潼区建筑工程公司（以下简称临潼公司）与陕西恒升房地产开发有限公司（以下简称恒升公司）建设工程施工合同纠纷一案，陕西省高级人民法院于2007年3月19日作出（2006）陕民一初字第15号民事判决。临潼公司不服该判决，向本院提起上诉。本院依法组成合议庭于2007年9月21日进行了开庭审理。临潼公司的委托代理人韩松、王东宽，恒升公司的委托代理人翟存柱、郝雅玲到庭参加诉讼。本案现已审理终结。

一审法院经审理查明：2003年3月10日，临潼公司依照约定进入恒升公司位于陕西省西安市建工路8号的恒升大厦综合楼工程工地进行施工。同年9月10日，临潼公司与恒升公司签订《建设工程施工合同》，约定：恒升公司（甲方）将其建设的恒升大厦综合楼项目的土建、安装、设备及装饰、装修和配套设施等工程发包给临潼公司（乙方）。开竣工日期：2003年3月10日至2005年9月10日。合同价款：承包总价以决算为准，由乙方包工包料。价款计算以设计施工图纸加变更作为依据。土建工程执行99定额，安装工程执行2001定额，按相关配套文件进行取费，工程所用材料定额规定需要做差价的以当期信息价为准。定额信息价购买不到的，甲乙双方协商议价，高出定额部分作差价处理。施工现场签证作为合同价款组成部分并入合同价款内。价款支付及调整：工程施工到正负零时，甲方向乙方首次支付已完工程量95％的工程款。正负零以下工程，作为乙方第一次报量期。正负零以上工程，由乙方每月25日将当月工程量报甲方，经其审核后在次月1-3日内将上月所完工程量价款95％支付给乙方。竣工与决算：已完工程验收后，乙方应在15天内提出决算，甲方收到决算后在30天内审核完毕，甲方无正当理由在批准竣工报告后30天内不办理结算，从第31天起按施工企业向银行计划外贷款的利率支付拖欠工程款利息，并承担违约责任。违约与索赔：甲方不按合同约定履行自己的各项义务、支付款项及发生其他使合同无法履行的行为，应承担违约责任。相应顺延工期，按协议条款约定支付违约金和赔偿因其违约给乙方造成的窝工等损失。乙方不能按合同工期竣工，按协议条款约定支付违约金，赔偿因违约给甲方造成的损失。双方施工现场总代表人：甲方何西京，乙方张安明。合同还对双方应负责在开工前办理的事项、材料设备供应、设计、质量与验收等均作了具体明确的约定。

2004年4月5日，西安市城乡建设监察大队对未经招标的恒升大厦综合楼工程进行了处罚，恒升公司即委托临潼公司张安明在西安市招投标办公室补办了工程报建手续，双方所签合同已经备案。诉讼中双方持有的合同，内容区别是有无29－3条。恒升公司持有西安市城市建设档案馆出具的备案合同附有此条。其内容为：本工程为乙方垫资工程，以实结算，实做实收，按工程总价优惠8个点，工程结算以本合同为准。

2005年2月2日，恒升公司与临潼公司、设计单位、监理公司等就恒升大厦综合楼地基与基础分部工程，主体（1～10层）分部工程进行验收，认定该工程为合格工程。11～24层主体工程已完工但未进行竣工验收，恒升公司承认主体已封顶。同年2月26日，临潼公司作出恒升大厦综合楼《建设工程主体完决算书》，决算工程造价为31020507.31元，并主张已送达恒升公司，但无恒升公司签收的文字记录及其他证据佐证，恒升公司不予认可。后双方发生纠纷，致使工程于2005年4月停工至今。

一审法院依据临潼公司申请，委托陕西华春建设项目管理有限责任公司对恒升大厦综合楼已完工程造价和截至2006年6月22日的停窝工损失进行鉴定。2006年11月25日、2007年1月12日，陕西华春建设项目管理有限责任公司作出华春鉴字（2006）07号鉴定报告及对该报告的异议答复、补充意见确认：恒升大厦综合楼已完工程造价为20242313.44元；2004年4月至2006年6月22日的停窝工损失为346421.84元。该工程造价中混凝土使用现场搅拌价，且按工程总造价优惠8个点即1818793.15元及四项保险费175452.75元。对该鉴定结论，临潼公司认为该工程造价应依照合同约定采用信息价；商品砼应采用购买价；备案合同29－3内容是恒升公司事后添加的，所以优惠8个点即1818793.15元没有依据。恒升公司则认为，临潼公司停工的原因完全在于其自身，故停窝工损失根本没有计算的合法依据。

恒升公司主张已支付工程款12219182.8元，但临潼公司仅对2004年6月20日、9月15日张安明以工程款内容签收的175万元予以确认。对其他款项一审法院依据庭审质证意见作以下分类：（一）项下2773932.40元恒升公司认为全部用于工程，应认定为已付工程款。临潼公司认可该笔款项用于工程，但认为是归还其借款480万元。（二）项下款项共计680万元，恒升公司主张依张安明要求支付至陕西致圣装饰工程有限公司（以下简称致圣公司），因张安明系该公司总经理。对此临潼公司不予认可，认为收款主体非临潼公司。（三）项下款项208410元，恒升公司主张由于临潼公司施工中不慎造成的支出，应认定为已付工程款。临潼公司认为依照监理公司的签证应由恒升公司承担。（四）项下款项686840.4元，恒升公司认为临潼公司口头承诺从工程款中予以扣减，应认定为已付工程款。临潼公司认为与本案无关，不予认可。

另查明：临潼公司工地代表张安明，系致圣公司总经理，该公司的法定代表人张宏发与其系父子关系。

临潼公司2006年5月15日起诉至一审法院称：2003年9月10日，临潼公司与恒升公司签订《建设工程施工合同》，约定：由临潼公司包工包料承包恒升大厦综合楼工程，恒升公司按工程进度向其支付工程价款。工程施工到正负零时，恒升公司向临潼公司首次支付已完工程量95％的工程价款。正负零以上工程，由临潼公司每月25日报告当月工程量，经恒升公司审核后在次月1～3日将上月所完成工程量价款95％支付给临潼公司。若恒升公司不能依约支付工程款项，应赔偿因违约给临潼公司造成的损失，并支付逾期付款利息。临潼公司先后完成正负零以下工程、大厦主体工程，经验收均为合格，但恒升公司仅付工程款284万元。故请求：判令恒升公司立即支付拖欠的工程款29480391.06元及逾期利息2825417元；判令恒升公司赔偿临潼公司停、窝工损失200万元；判令恒升公司承担本案诉讼费用。

恒升公司辩称，双方签订《建设工程施工合同》属实，但对该工程进行施工的不是临潼公司，而是借用临潼公司资质的个人包工头张安明。本案合同项目为商业、住宅用途的商品房，关系社会公共利益、公共安全，但对施工单位的选定却未进行招标投标工作，违反了法律、法规的强制性规定，本案合同应当认定无效，临潼公司主张的利息及损失的诉讼请求依法应予驳回；在施工过程中恒升公司多次替张安明支付材料款、水电费，并将部分工程款支付至其指定的致圣公司。截至目前，恒升公司支付的各项工程款为12219182.8元，但张安明从未按合同约定向恒升公司申报过工程量及申请支付工程款，故对造成的拖欠工程款、停窝工损失不承担责任。

一审法院经审理认为，临潼公司与恒升公司双方签订并经西安市城乡建设委员会备案的建设工程施工合同，系双方当事人真实意思表示，张安明作为工地负责人组织施工，该工程应视为临潼公司实施完成，该合同内容不违反法律、行政法规的强制性规定，应依法有效。审理中双方当事人持有的合同内容不同，但鉴于备案合同手续是由临潼公司工地代表张安明办理，且一审法院对备案合同中有关29－3条内容到西安市城市建设档案馆进行了核查，故对备案合同应予以认定并作为结算依据。依照合同中对工程所用材料约定，定额规定需要做差价的以当期信息价为准，而混凝土不属于需要做差价的材料，不能采用信息价。一审庭审中，临潼公司未提供外购商品混凝土的相关证据，涉案工程也不在政府强制使用商品混凝土的范围内，故鉴定结论中混凝土采用现场搅拌价计算恒升大厦已完工程造价依据充分，临潼公司主张采用信息价计算造价及商品砼采用购买价的理由不能成立。同时该报告依据备案合同约定在总造价中优惠8个点并扣除四项保险费，符合合同和法律规定，应予采信。临潼公司未提供29－3条系事后添加的相关证据，故其主张不应在总造价中优惠8个点的理由不能成立。鉴定报告确定恒升大厦综合楼已完工程造价为20242313.44元，客观真实应予以采信。对于恒升公司已付的175万元工程款双方无争议予以确认。依照合同承包总价以决算为准由乙方包工包料的约定，对于临潼公司认可用于工程的（一）项下内容，因其没有证据证明借款事实的存在，故其主张的恒升公司归还借款的理由不能成立。对于（二）项下款项，恒升公司本应支付至临潼公司，但由于张安明既是临潼公司驻工地代表，又是致圣公司总经理，恒升公司主张应张安明要求支付至此理由成立，对于该公司签收的九笔580万元，应认定为已付工程款。对于2002年12月24日支付的100万元，因发生在双方进场、签订合同之前，且合同中并无预付款的特别约定，故不予认定。对于（三）项下共计208410元，是临潼公司在施工中不慎发生天然气泄漏事故造成，应以监理公司的签证为依据认定责任，由临潼公司承担。对于租房费用因系工地实际发生费用，亦应由临潼公司承担，应认定为已付工程款。（四）项下共计686840.4元，与本案工程无关联性，不予认定。综上，恒升公司已付工程款为10532342.4元。对临潼公司起诉请求的下欠工程款利息，因该工程未竣工，工程价款亦未结算，故依据最高人民法院审理建设工程施工合同纠纷案件法律适用的相关规定，应从起诉之日起计算。由于临潼公司未按合同约定申报工程量及申请支付工程款，亦未提供监理公司确认的停窝工证据，故对其主张的停窝工损失不予采信。据此判决：（一）临潼公司与恒升公司签订并备案的《建设工程施工合同》依法有效；（二）恒升公司于判决生效之日起30日内支付临潼公司工程款9709971.04元及利息（自2006年5月15日起按照同期同类银行贷款利率计息）。逾期履行，按照《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第二百三十二条之规定，加倍支付迟延履行期间的债务利息；（三）驳回临潼公司的其他诉讼请求。案件受理费181539元、诉讼保全费10520元、鉴定费30万元，共计492059元，由临潼公司与恒升公司各承担246029.50元。

临潼公司不服一审判决，向本院提起上诉称：1.本项工程因周边环境所限，不能在施工现场进行混凝土搅拌作业，整个大厦全部使用商品混凝土，诉讼中恒升公司也没有否认大厦实际使用商品混凝土的事实，只是强调要以实际购买价结算。一审判决按照现场搅拌混凝土价格计算工程造价，有违公平，恒升公司应按照鉴定报告以商品混凝土市场信息价计算的工程款向临潼公司支付工程欠款及利息。2.一审判决以临潼公司未按合同约定申报工程量及申请支付工程款，亦未提供监理公司确认的停窝工证据为由，对停窝工损失不予认定明显错误。3.恒升公司提交的存档合同文本是经过篡改和伪造的，不能作为定案的依据。双方2003年9月10日签订的《建设工程施工合同》一式四份均经备案，双方各持一份，存档两份。本案中恒升公司开始提供的合同文本与临潼公司提交的合同文本并无差异，在工程造价鉴定结果出来之后又提供添加了29－3款的存档文本。29－3款的字迹明显与前款不同，非一人所写，同时其内容又明显与其他条款相矛盾。4.一审判决认定恒升公司已经向临潼公司支付了1053万元工程款与实际不符。其一，（一）项下的277万元，临潼公司确实收到该款项，也用于工程建设，但系恒升公司归还之前所借债务。其二，一审判决认定恒升公司向致圣公司支付的580万元全部为恒升公司付给临潼公司的工程款是错误的,对于致圣公司收款收据上写明是恒升大厦工程款的340万元予以认可。其三，临潼公司是在执行恒升公司指令的施工方案时发生的事故，对此造成的实际损失，恒升公司当时就承诺完全由其承担，此事不仅有监理公司出具字据为证，也有其实际支付相关费用的事实相佐。5.一审判决恒升公司支付欠款利息的起息日不当，恒升公司约定给付工程款而不予给付，即属迟延履行合同义务，利息就应当产生，而不应从临潼公司起诉之日开始计息。为了简化违约利息计算的复杂性，请求从2005年4月12日停工之日起开始计息。故请求撤销一审判决；改判恒升公司支付工程款22173276.52元及利息，并赔偿停窝工损失346421.60元；一审、二审案件受理费、保全费、鉴定费由恒升公司承担。

[Translation]

Xi'an Lintong District Construction Engineering Company v. Shaanxi Hengsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.
— Dispute over construction project construction contract

Ruling Summary

Article 21 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law for the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts, which provides that "where the parties enter into a separate construction project construction contract for the same construction project which materially differs in substantive content from the bid-winning contract that has been filed for record, the filed bid-winning contract shall serve as the basis for settling the project cost," means that where the parties sign two different versions of a contract for the same construction project, in the event of a dispute, the bid-winning contract filed for record shall serve as the basis for settling the project cost, and not that the archived contract text shall serve as the basis for settling the project cost.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court
(2007) Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 74

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): Xi'an Lintong District Construction Engineering Company, domiciled at No. 21 Dongguan Street, Lintong District, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province.
Legal Representative: Sun Gang, General Manager of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Han Song, lawyer of Beijing Kangda Law Firm, Xi'an Branch.
Agent ad litem: Wang Dongkuan, employee of the Company.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance): Shaanxi Hengsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 4 Daxin Lane, Dongguan South Street, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province.
Legal Representative: He Xijing, General Manager of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Zhai Cunzhu, lawyer of Beijing Zhongkai Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Hao Yaling, lawyer of Beijing Zhongkai Law Firm.

With respect to the case of Xi'an Lintong District Construction Engineering Company (hereinafter referred to as Lintong Company) v. Shaanxi Hengsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hengsheng Company) concerning a dispute over a construction project construction contract, the Shaanxi High People's Court rendered the Civil Judgment (2006) Shan Min Yi Chu Zi No. 15 on March 19, 2007. Lintong Company, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed to this Court. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and held a hearing on September 21, 2007. Han Song and Wang Dongkuan, the agents ad litem of Lintong Company, and Zhai Cunzhu and Hao Yaling, the agents ad litem of Hengsheng Company, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The case has now been concluded.

The court of first instance found the following facts upon trial: On March 10, 2003, Lintong Company entered the construction site of the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project located at No. 8 Jiangong Road, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province, for construction in accordance with the agreement. On September 10 of the same year, Lintong Company and Hengsheng Company signed a Construction Project Construction Contract, stipulating: Hengsheng Company (Party A) contracted to Lintong Company (Party B) the civil works, installation, equipment, decoration, finishing, and supporting facilities for the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project it was developing. Commencement and completion dates: March 10, 2003, to September 10, 2005. Contract price: The total contract price shall be based on the final account, with Party B providing both labor and materials. The price calculation shall be based on the design and construction drawings plus modifications. The civil works shall implement the 1999 quota, the installation works shall implement the 2001 quota, and fees shall be charged according to relevant supporting documents. Where the quota stipulates that price differentials are required for materials used in the project, the current information price shall apply. Where materials cannot be purchased at the quota information price, Party A and Party B shall negotiate the price, and the portion exceeding the quota shall be treated as a price differential. Site visas shall be included in the contract price as a component thereof. Payment and adjustment of the price: When the project construction reaches the ground floor level (positive/negative zero), Party A shall make an initial payment to Party B of 95% of the completed works. Works below ground floor level shall be treated as Party B's first quantity reporting period. For works above ground floor level, Party B shall report the quantity of works for the current month to Party A by the 25th of each month. After review by Party A, it shall pay Party B 95% of the price of the works completed in the previous month within 1 to 3 days of the following month. Completion and final account: After acceptance of the completed works, Party B shall submit a final account within 15 days. After receiving the final account, Party A shall complete the review within 30 days. If Party A, without proper justification, fails to settle the account within 30 days after approval of the completion report, it shall pay interest on the overdue project funds at the interest rate for planned loans borrowed by construction enterprises from banks starting from the 31st day, and shall bear liability for breach of contract. Breach of contract and claims: If Party A fails to perform its obligations, make payments, or engages in other acts that prevent the performance of the contract as agreed, it shall bear liability for breach of contract. The construction period shall be extended accordingly, and liquidated damages shall be paid as agreed in the contract terms, along with compensation for losses such as idling of workers caused to Party B due to its breach. If Party B fails to complete the project within the contract period, it shall pay liquidated damages as agreed in the contract terms and compensate for losses caused to Party A due to its breach. The onsite representatives of both parties: Party A: He Xijing; Party B: Zhang Anming. The contract also made specific and clear stipulations regarding matters to be handled before commencement, supply of materials and equipment, design, quality, and acceptance, etc.

On April 5, 2004, the Xi'an Urban and Rural Construction Supervision Team imposed a penalty on the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project for not being tendered. Hengsheng Company then entrusted Zhang Anming of Lintong Company to go through the project filing procedures at the Xi'an Tendering and Bidding Office, and the contract signed by both parties was filed for record. The contracts held by the parties during the litigation differ in content as to the presence or absence of Article 29-3. The filed contract obtained by Hengsheng Company from the Xi'an City Construction Archives contains this clause. Its content is: This project is a project where Party B advances funds, settlement is based on actual costs, actual work done is paid for, and an 8 percent discount is applied to the total project price. The project settlement shall be based on this contract.

On February 2, 2005, Hengsheng Company, together with Lintong Company, the design unit, the supervision company, etc., conducted acceptance inspections on the foundation and basement works and the main structure (floors 1 to 10) of the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project, and determined the project to be qualified. The main structure for floors 11 to 24 was completed but not subject to completion acceptance inspection; Hengsheng Company admitted that the main structure had been topped out. On February 26 of the same year, Lintong Company prepared the Final Account for the Main Structure Completion of the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project, with the final account project cost being RMB 31,020,507.31, and claimed that it had been delivered to Hengsheng Company, but there was no written record of receipt by Hengsheng Company or other evidence to support this, and Hengsheng Company did not acknowledge it. Subsequently, a dispute arose between the parties, causing the project to be suspended since April 2005 and remains so to date.

Upon the application of Lintong Company, the court of first instance commissioned Shaanxi Huachun Construction Project Management Co., Ltd. to appraise the completed project cost of the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project and the losses due to work suspension and idling of workers as of June 22, 2006. On November 25, 2006, and January 12, 2007, Shaanxi Huachun Construction Project Management Co., Ltd. issued the Appraisal Report Huachun Jian Zi (2006) No. 07 and a response to objections to the report and supplementary opinions, confirming that the completed project cost of the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project was RMB 20,242,313.44; the losses due to work suspension and idling of workers from April 2004 to June 22, 2006, were RMB 346,421.84. In this project cost, concrete used the on-site mixing price, and an 8 percent discount of RMB 1,818,793.15 was applied to the total project cost, along with four types of insurance premiums totaling RMB 175,452.75. Regarding this appraisal conclusion, Lintong Company argued that the project cost should adopt the information price as per the contract; commercial concrete should adopt the purchase price; and the content of Article 29-3 of the filed contract was added by Hengsheng Company afterwards, so the 8 percent discount of RMB 1,818,793.15 had no basis. Hengsheng Company argued that the reason for the work suspension was entirely attributable to Lintong Company itself, so there was no legal basis for calculating the losses due to work suspension and idling of workers.

Hengsheng Company claimed that it had paid project funds totaling RMB 12,219,182.8, but Lintong Company only confirmed RMB 1.75 million received by Zhang Anming on June 20, 2004, and September 15, 2004, as project funds. With respect to other amounts, the court of first instance made the following classifications based on the evidence adduced at trial: (1) Under item (1), RMB 2,773,932.40, Hengsheng Company argued that it was all used for the project and should be recognized as paid project funds. Lintong Company acknowledged that this sum was used for the project but argued that it was repayment of a loan of RMB 4.8 million owed to it by Hengsheng Company. (2) Under item (2), a total of RMB 6.8 million, Hengsheng Company claimed that it was paid to Shaanxi Zhisheng Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Zhisheng Company) at the request of Zhang Anming, as Zhang Anming was the general manager of that company. Lintong Company did not acknowledge this, arguing that the recipient was not Lintong Company. (3) Under item (3), RMB 208,410, Hengsheng Company argued that this was an expense incurred due to negligence during Lintong Company's construction and should be recognized as paid project funds. Lintong Company argued that according to the supervision company's visa, this should be borne by Hengsheng Company. (4) Under item (4), RMB 686,840.4, Hengsheng Company argued that Lintong Company had orally promised to deduct this from the project funds and should be recognized as paid project funds. Lintong Company argued that it was unrelated to this case and did not acknowledge it.

It was also found that Zhang Anming, the on-site representative of Lintong Company, was the general manager of Zhisheng Company, and its legal representative, Zhang Hongfa, is his father.

On May 15, 2006, Lintong Company filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance, alleging: On September 10, 2003, Lintong Company and Hengsheng Company signed a Construction Project Construction Contract, stipulating that Lintong Company would contract the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project on a labor and material basis, and Hengsheng Company would pay the project price according to the progress of the works. When the project construction reached the ground floor level, Hengsheng Company was to make an initial payment to Lintong Company of 95% of the completed works. For works above ground floor level, Lintong Company was to report the quantity for the current month by the 25th of each month, and after review by Hengsheng Company, it was to pay 95% of the price of the works completed in the previous month to Lintong Company within 1 to 3 days of the following month. If Hengsheng Company failed to pay the project funds as agreed, it should compensate for losses caused to Lintong Company due to the breach and pay interest for overdue payment. Lintong Company successively completed the works below ground floor level and the main structure of the building, all of which were accepted as qualified, but Hengsheng Company only paid RMB 2.84 million in project funds. Therefore, Lintong Company requested: an order that Hengsheng Company immediately pay the overdue project funds of RMB 29,480,391.06 and overdue interest of RMB 2,825,417; an order that Hengsheng Company compensate Lintong Company for losses of RMB 2 million due to work suspension and idling of workers; and an order that Hengsheng Company bear the litigation costs of this case.

Hengsheng Company argued in its defense: It is true that the Construction Project Construction Contract was signed between the parties, but the construction of the project was not carried out by Lintong Company, but by a private contractor, Zhang Anming, who borrowed Lintong Company's qualifications. The contract project is a commercial and residential commodity housing project, which concerns social public interests and public safety, but no tendering and bidding procedures were conducted for the selection of the construction unit, which violates mandatory provisions of laws and regulations. Therefore, the contract in this case should be deemed invalid, and Lintong Company's claims for interest and losses should be dismissed as a matter of law. During the construction process, Hengsheng Company repeatedly paid material costs and utility fees on behalf of Zhang Anming and also paid part of the project funds to Zhisheng Company as designated by Zhang Anming. As of the present, the total project funds paid by Hengsheng Company amount to RMB 12,219,182.8, but Zhang Anming never reported the quantity of works or applied for payment of project funds to Hengsheng Company as stipulated in the contract. Therefore, Hengsheng Company should not bear liability for the overdue project funds and losses due to work suspension and idling of workers.

The court of first instance held upon trial that the construction project construction contract signed by Lintong Company and Hengsheng Company and filed for record with the Xi'an Urban and Rural Construction Committee represented the true intentions of both parties. Zhang Anming organized the construction as the person in charge of the site, and the project should be deemed as having been implemented and completed by Lintong Company. The content of the contract did not violate mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations and should be legally valid. During the trial, the contracts held by the parties differed in content, but since the procedures for filing the contract were handled by Zhang Anming, the on-site representative of Lintong Company, and the court of first instance verified the content of Article 29-3 in the filed contract at the Xi'an City Construction Archives, the filed contract should be recognized and used as the basis for settlement. According to the contract's stipulation regarding materials used in the project, where the quota stipulates that price differentials are required, the current information price shall apply. Concrete is not a material for which price differentials are required, so the information price cannot be used. At the trial of first instance, Lintong Company did not provide evidence regarding the purchase of commercial concrete, and the project in question was not within the scope of government-mandated use of commercial concrete. Therefore, the appraisal conclusion that the completed project cost of the Hengsheng Building was calculated using the on-site mixing price for concrete was well-founded, and Lintong Company's arguments for using the information price to calculate the cost and for commercial concrete to use the purchase price were untenable. At the same time, the report's application of an 8 percent discount to the total project cost and deduction of the four types of insurance premiums in accordance with the filed contract complied with the contract and the law and should be adopted. Lintong Company did not provide evidence that Article 29-3 was added afterwards, so its argument that the 8 percent discount should not be applied to the total project cost was untenable. The appraisal report determined that the completed project cost of the Hengsheng Building Comprehensive Building Project was RMB 20,242,313.44, which is objective and true and should be adopted. The RMB 1.75 million in project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company, which was not disputed by both parties, was confirmed. According to the contract's stipulation that the total contract price is based on the final account with Party B providing both labor and materials, with respect to the amounts under item (1) that Lintong Company acknowledged were used for the project, since it had no evidence of the existence of a loan, its claim that Hengsheng Company was repaying a loan was untenable. With respect to the amounts under item (2), Hengsheng Company should have paid them to Lintong Company, but since Zhang Anming was both the on-site representative of Lintong Company and the general manager of Zhisheng Company, Hengsheng Company's claim that it paid to Zhisheng Company at Zhang Anming's request was justified. The nine payments totaling RMB 5.8 million received by Zhisheng Company should be recognized as paid project funds. The RMB 1 million paid on December 24, 2002, occurred before both parties entered the site and signed the contract, and the contract had no special provisions for advance payment, so it was not recognized. The total amount of RMB 208,410 under item (3) was caused by a natural gas leak accident that occurred due to negligence during Lintong Company's construction. Based on the supervision company's visa for determining liability, this amount should be borne by Lintong Company. The rental expenses, being actual expenses incurred on the site, should also be borne by Lintong Company and should be recognized as paid project funds. The total amount of RMB 686,840.4 under item (4) was not related to the project in this case and was not recognized. In summary, the project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company amounted to RMB 10,532,342.4. With respect to the interest on the outstanding project funds claimed by Lintong Company, because the project was not completed and the project cost had not been settled, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the application of law for the trial of disputes over construction project construction contracts, the interest should be calculated from the date of filing the lawsuit. Since Lintong Company did not report the quantity of works or apply for payment of project funds as stipulated in the contract, nor did it provide evidence of losses due to work suspension and idling of workers confirmed by the supervision company, its claim for such losses was not adopted. Accordingly, the court rendered the following judgment: (1) The Construction Project Construction Contract signed between Lintong Company and Hengsheng Company and filed for record is legally valid; (2) Within 30 days of the effective date of this judgment, Hengsheng Company shall pay Lintong Company the project funds of RMB 9,709,971.04 and interest (calculated from May 15, 2006, at the loan interest rate of the same type and same period of the bank). In the event of overdue performance, in accordance with Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the debt for the delayed performance shall be doubled; (3) Lintong Company's other claims are dismissed. The case acceptance fee of RMB 181,539, the preservation fee of RMB 10,520, and the appraisal fee of RMB 300,000, totaling RMB 492,059, shall be borne equally by Lintong Company and Hengsheng Company, each paying RMB 246,029.50.

Lintong Company, dissatisfied with the judgment of first instance, appealed to this Court, arguing: 1. Due to environmental constraints of the surrounding area, concrete mixing operations could not be carried out on the construction site for this project. The entire building used commercial concrete. During the litigation, Hengsheng Company did not deny the fact that the building actually used commercial concrete, only emphasizing that the settlement should be based on the actual purchase price. The first instance judgment's calculation of the project cost using the on-site mixing concrete price was unfair. Hengsheng Company should pay the outstanding project funds and interest to Lintong Company based on the project cost calculated using the market information price for commercial concrete as per the appraisal report. 2. The first instance judgment's refusal to recognize the losses due to work suspension and idling of workers on the grounds that Lintong Company did not report the quantity of works or apply for payment of project funds as per the contract and did not provide evidence of such losses confirmed by the supervision company was clearly erroneous. 3. The archived contract text submitted by Hengsheng Company was altered and forged and cannot be used as the basis for deciding the case. The Construction Project Construction Contract signed by the parties on September 10, 2003, was made in four copies, all filed for record, with each party holding one copy and two copies archived. In this case, the contract text initially provided by Hengsheng Company was no different from the text submitted by Lintong Company. However, after the results of the project cost appraisal were obtained, Hengsheng Company provided the archived text with Article 29-3 added. The handwriting of Article 29-3 is obviously different from that of the preceding clause and was not written by the same person, and its content is clearly inconsistent with other clauses. 4. The first instance judgment's finding that Hengsheng Company had paid Lintong Company RMB 10.53 million in project funds does not correspond to the facts. First, with respect to the RMB 2.77 million under item (1), Lintong Company indeed received this sum and used it for the project, but it was a repayment of a debt previously borrowed from Lintong Company by Hengsheng Company. Second, the first instance judgment's finding that the RMB 5.8 million paid by Hengsheng Company to Zhisheng Company was entirely project funds paid to Lintong Company is erroneous. Lintong Company only acknowledges the RMB 3.4 million for which the receipt from Zhisheng Company indicated it was project funds for the Hengsheng Building. Third, the accident occurred when Lintong Company was executing the construction plan instructed by Hengsheng Company. Hengsheng Company promised at that time to bear all actual losses caused thereby. This is supported not only by a document issued by the supervision company but also by the fact that Hengsheng Company actually paid the relevant expenses. 5. The starting date for the interest on the outstanding project funds determined by the first instance judgment is inappropriate. When Hengsheng Company agreed to pay the project funds but failed to do so, it was a delay in performing its contractual obligations, and interest should have accrued from that time, not from the date when Lintong Company filed the lawsuit. To simplify the calculation of default interest, Lintong Company requests that interest be calculated from the date of work suspension, April 12, 2005. Therefore, Lintong Company requests that the first instance judgment be set aside; that the judgment be modified to order Hengsheng Company to pay project funds of RMB 22,173,276.52 and interest, and to compensate for losses due to work suspension and idling of workers of RMB 346,421.60; and that Hengsheng Company bear the case acceptance fees, preservation fees, and appraisal fees for the first and second instances.

Hengsheng Company argued in its defense: 1. Lintong Company's claim that the filed contract clause 29-3 was added without authorization was neither factual nor supported by sufficient evidence. Clause 29-3 in the filed contract was filled in by He Xijing after mutual consultation and agreement between the parties. The filing procedures for this contract were undertaken by Zhang Anming, the representative of the construction party, and He Xijing, the representative of the construction owner, together at the Construction Committee. Zhang Anming knew or should have known about the inclusion of clause 29-3 in the filed contract. According to the judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on construction project contracts, if a "yin-yang contract" situation arises in a construction project construction contract, i.e., a filed contract and an actually performed contract, the filed contract shall be deemed valid as a matter of law and shall serve as the basis for the project settlement. 2. Lintong Company failed to provide direct evidence proving that the concrete used in this case was commercially mixed concrete. Moreover, the location of the project in question was not within the scope where the government mandates the use of commercially mixed concrete; on-site mixing could be used entirely. According to the supplementary appraisal opinion of the first-instance appraisal institution, the concrete involved in this case should be priced based on the on-site mixing price. 3. The losses from work suspension and idleness were entirely caused by Lintong Company's own reasons. Therefore, the first-instance judgment correctly did not support Lintong Company's claim for losses from work suspension and idleness. 4. The payments made by Hengsheng Company to Zhisheng Company under the name of project funds should be recognized as project funds for the project in question. Lintong Company claims that among the payments made by Hengsheng Company, RMB 4.8 million was for repayment of a loan from Lintong Company. However, Lintong Company did not provide evidence proving the existence of the loan. Even if the loan existed, it would constitute a creditor-debtor relationship between the two parties, unrelated to this case, and Lintong Company should file a separate lawsuit. 5. The evidence provided by Hengsheng Company was sufficient to prove that the construction contract involved in this case was signed by Zhang Anming, the actual project constructor, using Lintong Company's qualification, and should be deemed invalid according to relevant legal provisions.

Facts found by this court of second instance: The appraisal report (Huachun Jian Zi (2006) No. 07) issued by Shaanxi Huachun Construction Project Management Co., Ltd. on November 25, 2006, states: "(1) The total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower, RMB 23,846,047.39, is the result calculated based on the assumption that the concrete used in the project was commercially mixed concrete and the unit price was the actual purchase price. The actual purchase price referred to here is the unit price of commercially mixed concrete in the 'Commercial Concrete Quotation from Shaanxi Yaobai Concrete Co., Ltd. for Huaye Co., Ltd.' provided by the defendant. The total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower appraised based on this unit price is relatively more accurate compared to the other two total costs. (2) The total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower, RMB 22,734,914.34, is the result calculated based on the assumption that the concrete used in the project was on-site mixed concrete. The location of the project was not within the scope where the local government mandates the use of commercially mixed concrete; on-site mixed concrete could be used and was more economical. (3) The total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower, RMB 25,297,208.92, is the result calculated based on the assumption that the concrete used in the project was commercially mixed concrete and the unit price was the current market information price." "The work suspension and idleness period for the project was from April 2004 to June 22, 2006, but the quantity was not certified by the site representative designated by the construction owner." The reply and supplementary opinion dated January 12, 2007, regarding objections to the appraisal report state: "The four types of insurance premiums included in the project cost should be deducted from the total cost, amounting to RMB 175,452.75; the cost of the completed works in the appraisal report should deduct the cost of the 90 thick GS panels for the parts below the sixth floor and above the seventeenth floor, amounting to RMB 498,355."

It was also found that a "Statement of Facts" issued by Shaanxi Chang'an Engineering Construction Supervision Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Chang'an Supervision Company) states: "1. The copy of the 'Construction Project Construction Contract' for the Hengsheng Tower Complex Building supervised by our project department only contained clauses 29-1 and 29-2 in the amended clauses under Article 29 on page 17. 2. At the special funding meeting on April 21, 2005, neither party raised the issue of funding advances or an 8% discount." A power of attorney archived in the Xi'an Urban Construction Archives indicates that Hengsheng Company authorized He Xijing to handle bidding procedures at the Xi'an Construction Committee Project Construction Approval Office. The "Construction Project Registration Form" also notes the handler was He Xijing. On March 15, 2004, Lintong Company issued a "Legal Representative Power of Attorney" to Hengsheng Company, authorizing Zhang Anming to handle the bidding matters for the Hengsheng Tower on behalf of Lintong Company.

Further found: On January 1, 2004, the Hengsheng Tower Project Department of Lintong Company prepared a construction plan for the foundation raft concrete of the Hengsheng Complex Tower, which clearly stated in Article 5: "Commercial concrete shall be used; the selection of concrete mix materials must be strictly controlled; cement shall be Yaobai brand P.O32.5 from Yaobai Stock Company; water shall be tap water." On January 10, 2004, Chang'an Supervision Company reviewed and approved the construction plan. The "Quality Assessment Reports" for the main structure (floors 1-10 and floors 11-24) of the Hengsheng Complex Tower, issued by Chang'an Supervision Company on October 18, 2004, and February 26, 2006, respectively, both state: "For commercial concrete and the mortar (mixed mortar) used in masonry, sufficient test blocks were retained as required by standards and subjected to standard curing, serving as the basis for evaluating the strength of concrete and mortar in the main structure." On June 2, 2005, Chang'an Supervision Company issued "Several Issues Requiring Clarification in the Audit Process of the Hengsheng Tower Project," which stated: "There is no material stack yard at the concrete mixing site; all concrete used in construction is externally purchased commercial concrete." Lintong Company also provided invoices for the purchase of commercial concrete from Shaanxi Yaobai Concrete Co., Ltd.

During the second-instance court hearing, Lintong Company provided an appraisal conclusion from the Judicial Appraisal Center of Northwest University of Political Science and Law, proving that clause 29-3 in the archived contract text was added privately by He Xijing of Hengsheng Company. Hengsheng Company argued that the appraisal conclusion from Northwest University of Political Science and Law only proved that clause 29-3 was written by He Xijing, a fact which was not in dispute and did not require any appraisal to prove.

Opinion of the Court: Based on the appellate claims of Lintong Company and the court hearing debates, the disputed issues between the parties are: (1) Which text of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" should serve as the basis for settlement for the project involved; (2) Whether the first-instance judgment was appropriate in calculating the completed cost of the Hengsheng Tower using the on-site mixing price for concrete; (3) The amount of project funds Hengsheng Company has already paid to Lintong Company; (4) Whether Lintong Company's claim for losses from work suspension and idleness should be supported; (5) From when should Hengsheng Company start paying interest on the overdue project funds to Lintong Company.

(1) Regarding which text of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" should serve as the basis for settlement for the project involved.

Hengsheng Company and Lintong Company signed the "Construction Project Construction Contract" on September 10, 2003, which was filed with the Xi'an Urban and Rural Construction Committee on April 5, 2004. The content of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" texts provided by both parties to the first-instance court within the first-instance evidence submission period was consistent, i.e., without the content of clause 29-3. The "Statement of Facts" issued by Chang'an Supervision Company also proves that the text of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" did not contain the content of clause 29-3. Article 11 of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" addressed the issue of project progress payments, clearly stipulating the specific project progress and payment deadlines. Hengsheng Company itself claimed to have paid RMB 12,219,182.8 in project funds to Lintong Company. The content of clause 29-3 is clearly inconsistent with Article 11 of the "Construction Project Construction Contract."

Article 21 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts" stipulates: "If the parties enter into another construction contract for the same construction project and its substantive content is inconsistent with the filed winning bid contract, the filed winning bid contract shall serve as the basis for settling the project price." This article refers to a situation where the parties sign two different versions of a contract for the same construction project; when a dispute arises, the filed winning bid contract shall serve as the basis for settling the project price, not the archived contract text. The text of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" archived in the Xi'an Urban Construction Archives submitted by Hengsheng Company had clause 29-3 written by He Xijing of Hengsheng Company, with no evidence proving that this clause was established through consultation and agreement between the parties. Therefore, the "Construction Project Construction Contract" text with the same content submitted by both parties before the expiry of the first-instance evidence submission period shall serve as the basis for settling the project amount in this case. The first-instance judgment, based solely on the existence of the "Legal Representative Power of Attorney" issued by Lintong Company to Hengsheng Company in the supplementary bidding procedures file, found that the filing contract procedures were handled by Zhang Anming, the site representative of Lintong Company, and used the archived contract text submitted by Hengsheng Company as the basis for project price settlement. This lacked factual and legal basis and should be corrected by this court.

(2) Whether the first-instance judgment was appropriate in calculating the completed cost of the Hengsheng Tower using the on-site mixing price for concrete.

Based on the specific requirements for using commercial concrete in the Hengsheng Tower design and construction plan, the evaluation conclusion in the Chang'an Supervision Company's main structure quality assessment report that using commercial concrete complied with standards, the Chang'an Supervision Company's statement that all concrete used was commercial concrete, and a series of evidence including Lintong Company's invoices for purchasing commercial concrete from Shaanxi Yaobai Concrete Co., Ltd., this is sufficient to prove that the project involved used commercial concrete, not on-site mixed concrete. The appraisal report (Huachun Jian Zi (2006) No. 07) on the completed project cost of the Hengsheng Tower Complex Building issued by Shaanxi Huachun Construction Project Management Co., Ltd. also stated, "The total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower, RMB 23,846,047.39, is the result calculated based on the assumption that the concrete used in the project was commercially mixed concrete and the unit price was the actual purchase price. The total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower appraised based on this unit price is relatively more accurate compared to the other two total costs." Therefore, the total construction cost of the completed works of Hengsheng Tower should be based on the RMB 23,846,047.39 in the appraisal conclusion. Neither Hengsheng Company's claim for calculating the project cost using the on-site concrete mixing price nor Lintong Company's claim for calculating the project cost using the market information price of commercial concrete is credible.

(3) Regarding the amount of project funds Hengsheng Company has already paid to Lintong Company.

The first-instance judgment determined the amount of project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company as RMB 10,532,342.4. Lintong Company argues this determination is erroneous. Lintong Company raises objections in three aspects. First, it claims that a loan of RMB 4.8 million from Hengsheng Company should be deducted from the project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company. This court holds that Lintong Company's claim in the lawsuit is for an order that Hengsheng Company pay the overdue project funds and interest and compensate for losses from work suspension and idleness. Payment of project funds and a loan are two different legal relationships. Lintong Company's claim to directly deduct the RMB 4.8 million loan from the project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company lacks corresponding legal basis and is not supported by this court. The loan issue raised by Lintong Company should be resolved separately. Second, Lintong Company claims that the RMB 5.8 million paid by Hengsheng Company to Zhisheng Company should not all be recognized as project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company. This court holds that, generally speaking, regarding the determination of the amount of project funds already paid, the payee should be Lintong Company. If payment was made to another entity at the request of Lintong Company, Hengsheng Company should provide evidence of Lintong Company's authorization for such payment. Hengsheng Company did not provide such evidence. Given that Lintong Company has already acknowledged RMB 3.4 million thereof as project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company, the RMB 3.4 million paid by Hengsheng Company to Zhisheng Company should be recognized as project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company. Third, Lintong Company claims that expenses of RMB 208,410 incurred due to a natural gas leakage accident should be borne by Hengsheng Company. This court holds that for the expenses of RMB 208,410 incurred due to the natural gas leakage accident, the final statement issued by Chang'an Supervision Company should be relied upon. Lintong Company's claim that Hengsheng Company should bear these expenses lacks sufficient basis and is not credible. In summary, the amount of project funds already paid by Hengsheng Company should be determined as RMB 8,132,342.4.

(4) Whether Lintong Company's claim for losses from work suspension and idleness should be supported.

This court holds: Although the appraisal report issued by Shaanxi Huachun Construction Project Management Co., Ltd. on November 25, 2006, calculated the losses from work suspension and idleness for the Hengsheng Tower project as RMB 346,421.84, the report also clearly states: "The work suspension and idleness period for the project was from April 2004 to June 22, 2006, but the quantity was not certified by the site representative designated by the construction owner." The first-instance judgment did not support Lintong Company's claim for losses from work suspension and idleness on the grounds that Lintong Company did not declare the project quantity and apply for payment in accordance with the contract, nor did it provide evidence of work suspension and idleness confirmed by the supervision company. Since Lintong Company also failed to provide relevant evidence to support its claim in the second instance, its appeal request that Hengsheng Company pay RMB 346,421.84 for losses from work suspension and idleness as calculated in the appraisal report is also not supported by this court.

(5) From when should Hengsheng Company start paying interest on the overdue project funds to Lintong Company.

This court holds that, according to Article 18 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts": "Interest shall be calculated from the date on which the project price is due. If the parties have not agreed on the payment time or the agreement is unclear, the following times shall be deemed as the due time for payment: (1) If the construction project has actually been delivered, the date of delivery; (2) If the construction project has not been delivered, the date of submission of the completion settlement documents; (3) If the construction project has not been delivered and the project price has not been settled, the date on which the party files the lawsuit." If the contract contains an agreement, the agreement of the parties shall be followed. Only when the parties have no agreement on the payment time or the agreement is unclear should the provisions of this judicial interpretation be applied according to different circumstances. Looking at the agreement in the "Construction Project Construction Contract" signed by the parties in this case, it was agreed that when the project construction reaches the ground level (plus/minus zero), Party A (the owner) shall make the first payment to Party B (the contractor) of 95% of the project price for the completed works. The works below ground level shall be treated as Party B's first quantity reporting period. For works above ground level, Party B shall report the monthly quantity to Party A by the 25th of each month, and after review by Party A, the price for 95% of the completed works for the previous month shall be paid to Party B within 1-3 days of the following month. Therefore, the first-instance judgment's decision that Hengsheng Company should start paying interest on the overdue project funds from the date Lintong Company filed the lawsuit was inappropriate and is corrected by this court. Lintong Company's claim that interest should be paid from April 12, 2005, the date of work suspension, is granted by this court.

In summary, pursuant to Article 153(1)(b) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Affirm items 1 and 3 of the Civil Judgment (2006) Shan Min Yi Chu Zi No. 15 of the Shaanxi High People's Court;

2. Amend item 2 of the Civil Judgment (2006) Shan Min Yi Chu Zi No. 15 of the Shaanxi High People's Court to: Shaanxi Hengsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. shall, within 30 days from the effective date of this judgment, pay Xi'an Lintong District Construction Engineering Company project funds of RMB 15,039,897.24 and interest (calculated from April 12, 2005, at the same-period loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China).

If the monetary payment obligation under this judgment is not fulfilled within the period specified, the interest on the debt for the period of delayed performance shall be doubled in accordance with Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Court acceptance fees for the first instance shall be executed in accordance with the first-instance judgment; court acceptance fees for the second instance amount to RMB 181,539, of which Shaanxi Hengsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. shall bear RMB 72,616, and Xi'an Lintong District Construction Engineering Company shall bear RMB 108,923.

This judgment is final.
